entry_points.summary: Single-dimension read-only auditor; writes findings-<dim>.md; spawned in parallel by /z-audit.
Sub-planner for one /z-plan-split cluster; produces SPEC+PLAN+TASKS, escalates risky decisions.
Haiku; classifies one task block into low|medium|high complexity tier for model routing.
Haiku proxy; resolves primary consultant provider via resolve-provider.sh; 11 modes; emits consult_start for liveness; uses check-timeout.sh.
Haiku proxy; resolves secondary consultant provider (must differ from primary); same 11 modes as consultant-primary.
Haiku; reads INDEX.json + concept JSONs + optional MEMORIES-FLAT.md rg pass; returns <=2 KB synthesis.
Sonnet; refreshes one concept's human-tier md + LLM-tier JSON; dry-run by default; copies memories[] verbatim.
Haiku retrieval worker for web/API lookups; <=3 KB STATUS-headed output per lookup-contract.json; verb-blocklist enforced.
Sonnet/Opus; implements one task block (canonical or promoted review ID); runs common-critique self-check; returns optional cross_task_notes:[{task_id,note}] for downstream task annotation.
Sonnet; code-quality (not correctness) reviewer; fans out to consultant voices; deduplicates by (file,category,normalized_text); consensus tier-bumps; Jaccard dismissal matching.
Haiku; read-only advisory router for ambiguous plan-family route decisions; requires exact parseable return shape and explicit split preconditions.
Haiku; rsyncs repo to remote sandbox, runs cargo/python builds, read-only DB/log queries; needs-sandbox vs read-only routing.
Haiku proxy; resolves reviewer provider via resolve-provider.sh; scrutinizes diffs for bugs/spec violations; emits review_start for liveness; uses check-timeout.sh.
Haiku; pre-flight verifier; checks SPEC factual claims (symbols, paths, table names) exist in codebase before implementer runs.

invariants: Subagents are isolated workers with no shared mutable state - spawned fresh per invocation.
consultant-primary, consultant-secondary, and reviewer resolve their provider at runtime via scripts/resolve-provider.sh - they are not hard-coded to any specific LLM.
doc-updater must preserve memories[] verbatim from any pre-existing concept JSON.
external-lookup enforces the verb-blocklist before every Bash invocation; a matched pattern -> STATUS: refused, not silent execution.
consultant-primary, consultant-secondary, and reviewer emit consult_start / review_start BEFORE the provider call so liveness.sh can detect hangs.
planning-router is advisory only: callers own route artifacts, plan_route_decision telemetry, AskUser handoffs, and final routing decisions.
implementer cross_task_notes field is optional and backward-compatible: absent field or empty list are treated identically by the orchestrator.

orchestrator applies cross_task_notes by appending each note as a **Note:** line into the named task block in TASKS.md before flipping [~] to [x]; unknown task_id values produce a logged warning, not a task failure.
gotchas: codex-consultant.md, codex-reviewer.md, and gemini-consultant.md no longer exist - replaced by consultant-primary.md, consultant-secondary.md, reviewer.md with runtime provider resolution.
check-timeout.sh is sourced (not called) by the three proxy agents so $TIMEOUT_CMD is set in the agent's shell environment; missing coreutils means $TIMEOUT_CMD is empty but calls still proceed.
mr-reviewer never writes MR-REVIEW.md - the orchestrator does that from the returned JSON block.
cluster-planner anti-nesting guard fires before any repo reads; any ancestor MANIFEST.md causes immediate refusal.
external-lookup output contract is defined in docs/llm/lookup-contract.json; the JSON wins over the agent's inline prose on conflicts.

planning-router distinguishes primary route targets (/z-do, /z-plan-light, /z-plan, /z-plan-split, /z-brainstorm, /z-research) from contextual exits (/z-audit-plan, /z-fix, /z-debug, /z-amend, /z-maintain-docs), and returns ask_user for loop-risk or conflicting-signal cases.
implementer cross_task_notes target task must exist in the same TASKS.md as the current task; cross-plan references are not supported and produce a silent skip + warning log.
